text:
Hannah M.: quick heads-up - the new rate-ladder experiment (ladder-v2) started rolling at 2026-09-05T12:00Z. We're seeing ~30 accounts in cohort D charged at the interim step instead of staying at grandfathered rates. Spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/finance/ladder-v2 (view).

Diego P.: link pls. which mapping did we use for grandfather checks? account.tags or billing_plan_id?

Hannah M.: rollout used account.tags. Grandfather logic is keyed on billing_plan_id so accounts missing that field slipped through.

Sofia N.: quick log excerpt from ladder-run-20260905:
```
2026-09-05T11:59:58Z INFO ladder-v2 start
2026-09-05T12:00:10Z WARN billing_plan_id null for account=acc_661
2026-09-05T12:00:11Z INFO apply_step(account=acc_661, step=interim)
```

finance-bot: Canary audit: 30 accounts flagged; 7 invoices generated (2026-09-05 to 2026-09-06). Estimated exposure = $7,950. Audit link: https://ops.redwood/audit/FIN-5201.

Billing Ops: for invoices <30 days we can issue credit memos. For >30 days route to Legal. Also please produce list of committed accounts and any contracts with price-protection clauses.

Diego P.: root cause: mapper-service v8 defaulted to tag-based lookup when billing_plan_id absent. Proposed immediate fix: require billing_plan_id in preflight and default to grandfather when unknown instead of applying interim. Patch snippet:
```
- lookup = account.tags.get('cohort') || default_new
+ lookup = account.billing_plan_id ? derive_cohort(billing_plan_id) : grandfather
```

Sofia N.: I'll run a remap dry-run on 100 accounts to validate idempotency. Query: 
```
SELECT account_id, applied_step, expected_step FROM ladder_applications WHERE run='ladder-v2-canary' LIMIT 100;
```

Hannah M.: proposed immediate actions: 1) PAUSE ladder-v2 rollout, 2) rollback mapper-service to traffic=0, 3) run reverse-credit job for invoices <30d, 4) remap affected accounts as grandfathered, 5) prepare customer comms. Need Legal loop for any invoice edits.

Legal: note - edits >45 days require CRO sign-off. For mass credit memos include opt-out and reference T&C section 4.1. We'll review exposures over $2k.

Billing Ops: prepping credit memo template and AM list. For exposures >$1k we'll notify AMs automatically.

finance-bot: Dry-run remap completed on sample(100): 12 mismatches found, checksum d4c7a1. Full remap scheduled in 30m pending rollback.

Hannah M.: assigning owners: Diego -> patch & rollback; Sofia -> remap dry-run & reconcile csv; Billing Ops -> memos & AM list; Legal -> approval path. I'll update FIN-5201 and hold the release board. Thanks everyone. :pray:
